title: Where the energy goes on a rough slope
caption: Sliding 5.0 m down the 30° slope, the block loses 49 J of potential energy. Friction (a non-conservative force) turns 20 J into heat; the remaining 29 J is kinetic energy, giving v = 5.39 m s⁻¹.
alt: Energy flow diagram: 49 joules of potential energy in, 29 joules out as kinetic energy and 20 joules as heat from friction.
description: Work against friction: 4.0 × 5 = 20 J, becoming heat.
Kinetic energy gained: 49 − 20 = 29 J, so v = √(2 × 29 / 2) = 5.39 m s⁻¹.
